custom_css: .page-content {max-width: 1500px; margin: 30px auto; padding: 25px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0fff4, #e0f7fa); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); font-family: Poppins, sans-serif;}
.page-content input,.page-content textarea {width: 100%; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 8px;}
.page-content button {background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00b09b, #96c93d); color: #fff; border: 0; padding: 10px 15px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer;}
